```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:custom="http://example.com/custom" custom:id="001">
  <!-- Comment containing special characters <>&'" -->
  <?custom-pi target="process" data="value"?>
  <child>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with entity reference &internal; and tags <foo></foo>
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record+)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pfx "rec">
  <!ENTITY % dtddecl "<!ELEMENT %pfx; (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtddecl;
  <!ENTITY copyright "Copyright (C) 2023">
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<database xmlns="http://example.org/db" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Header comment for database -->
  <rec>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw text data with symbols: <tag> & </tag>
    ]]>
  </rec>
  <rec>©right;</rec>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "Second &ent1; Entity">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="verbose"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/catalog" xmlns:m="http://example.com/meta">
  <!-- Catalog metadata and items -->
  <m:info>
    <?m:action execute="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <m:data>Embedded XML-like structure inside CDATA</m:data>
    ]]>
  </m:info>
  <item>&ent2;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local_macro "<!ENTITY shared 'SharedString'>">
  %local_macro;
  <!ENTITY author "John Doe">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css" type="text/css"?>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:doc="http://doc.org/ns">
  <!-- Document root comment -->
  <?doc-processor mode="strict"?>
  <section id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      Section 1 CDATA section with &shared; and <markup>
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section id="s2">&shared; by &author;</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY company "Acme Corp">
  <!ENTITY slogan "&company;: Quality First">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "README.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-log target="syslog" priority="critical"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://acme.com/inv" xmlns:inv="http://acme.com/inv">
  <!-- Inventory list containing products -->
  <?inv-action type="refresh"?>
  <product code="A1">
    <![CDATA[
      Product description with &slogan; and <tags>
    ]]>
  </product>
  <product code="A2">&slogan;</product>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (entry*)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext_ent SYSTEM "external.ent">
  %ext_ent;
  <!ENTITY default_val "DefaultValue">
]>
<?xml-resource type="catalog" uri="cat.xml"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:arc="http://archive.org/schema">
  <!-- Archive contents comment -->
  <?arc-meta author="admin" status="active"?>
  <entry>
    <![CDATA[
      Archive CDATA entry with entities like &default_val;
    ]]>
  </entry>
  <entry>&default_val;</entry>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY admin_email "admin@example.com">
  <!ENTITY contact "Contact: &admin_email;">
  <!NOTATION bmp SYSTEM "image/bmp">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.bmp" NDATA bmp>
]>
<?xml-app-settings debug="false"?>
<config xmlns="http://example.org/config" xmlns:cfg="http://example.org/config">
  <!-- Configuration settings container -->
  <?cfg-info status="loaded"?>
  <setting name="mode">
    <![CDATA[
      Mode setting with CDATA and &contact;
    ]]>
  </setting>
  <setting name="support">&contact;</setting>
</config>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE library [
  <!ELEMENT library (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % chapter_macro "<!ENTITY sample_chapter 'Chapter One'>">
  %chapter_macro;
  <!ENTITY publisher "Global Books">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="print.xsl"?>
<library xmlns="http://library.org/ns" xmlns:lib="http://library.org/ns">
  <!-- Library books listing -->
  <?lib-action type="index"?>
  <book>
    <![CDATA[
      Book info: &sample_chapter; published by &publisher; <notes/>
    ]]>
  </book>
  <book>&sample_chapter;</book>
</library>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE workspace [
  <!ELEMENT workspace (project*)>
  <!ELEMENT project (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY proj_name "ProjectX">
  <!ENTITY proj_desc "Description of &proj_name;">
  <!NOTATION zip SYSTEM "application/zip">
  <!ENTITY bundle SYSTEM "source.zip" NDATA zip>
]>
<?xml-workspace-settings auto-save="true"?>
<workspace xmlns="http://workspace.org/ns" xmlns:ws="http://workspace.org/ns">
  <!-- Workspace projects overview -->
  <?ws-meta creator="user1"?>
  <project>
    <![CDATA[
      Workspace CDATA block: &proj_desc; <element>text</element>
    ]]>
  </project>
  <project>&proj_desc;</project>
</workspace>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (test*)>
  <!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % test_macro "<!ENTITY pass_msg 'Test Passed'>">
  %test_macro;
  <!ENTITY fail_msg "Test Failed">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="report.css"?>
<suite xmlns="http://test.org/ns" xmlns:t="http://test.org/ns">
  <!-- Test suite execution results -->
  <?t-exec env="staging" timestamp="12345"?>
  <test id="t1">
    <![CDATA[
      Execution details: &pass_msg; and &fail_msg; <xml></xml>
    ]]>
  </test>
  <test id="t2">&pass_msg;</test>
</suite>
```
